source_clauses.rationale: Keep deterministic candle proxy benchmark separate from executed signed flow/resilience; percentage-versus-fraction ambiguous until source code.

source_clauses.idea: Aggressive cohort markouts/memory; calendars separate learned post-event behavior; consensus/revision caution
source_clauses.rationale: Retain with no-memory/sign-shuffle and event stabilization alternatives

source_clauses.idea: Effort/reward, top-book resilience, absorption sequence with duration and optional retest
source_clauses.rationale: Retain branches, causal progress labels, sequence-prefix and latency-aware economics

source_clauses.idea: pp23-24 Jun8 width-conditioned break classification,1.2%+ wide range, midpoint retrace60.4%; top35% footprint transactions
source_clauses.rationale: Chart shows retreat from range high to midpoint, large302 marker and rejection; enlarged footprint negative delta concentrated low in bullish bar, thin terminal prints and later higher-low test. This supports an observable effort/progress/retest sequence hypothesis, not 'big print=absorption'. Retain trade-level challenger to bar proxy and source top35% filter as tunable benchmark.

source_clauses.idea: p25 Jun5 London1.33-1.66 exhaustion longs; May19 OR usage occasional; bigtrades100NY/75London
source_clauses.rationale: Chart displays exhaustion reversal and later lower-range retest with profile taper. Author explicitly says bubbles identify large executed bid/ask trades, not absorption. Retain separate size filter, time-session cohort calibration and absorption response.

source_clauses.idea: BBO flow/counts/reload/lifetime, spread/approach and failed traversal; regime→range gate→level grader→rules
source_clauses.rationale: Retain measurements and diagnosis, with finer decomposition than four experts. Quote lifetime is BBO-state persistence, not an individual order's lifetime. P-zone agreement, top-book hold and regime match are not mandatory intersections. No 4R stop or forced second test is adopted.

source_clauses.provenance: T2–4, ll90–213: long bar history versus newer delta; bar-proxy versus delta-C2 dilemma
source_clauses.idea: Long structural history and richer recent observations
source_clauses.rationale: Modify; OHLC signs are not actual delta; Separate schema/version/coverage heads and missingness-aware mixtures; overlap tests; validation: Same-date ablations, missing-expert simulation and distribution drift

source_clauses.provenance: B ll438–487: intensity/run length/tick speed/size mix/CVD slope/spread flicker, duration states and labels only at hits
source_clauses.idea: Precise pace and timescale definitions
source_clauses.rationale: Retain measurements; improve sampling; no assumed three-to-ten-second window; Event/clock intensity and size cohorts with background controls beside candidate windows; validation: Aggregation, sparsity, background matching and effort versus progress

source_clauses.idea: pp3–4: bids, asks, aggressive versus passive
source_clauses.rationale: p3 actual DOM EPZ25 has separate volume-at-price, resting size and executed bid/ask columns, largest displayed volume15325 at6660.75 and BBO near6659.50/75; static snapshot cannot show reload. Retain explicit event semantics. Marketable limit orders can be aggressive, quotes can move on cancellation; reject participant types or sole-cause movement stories as literal definitions. MBP1 provides BBO, not every price's resting depth.

source_clauses.idea: p5: delta per price = aggressive buy−sell; positive delta with no progress
source_clauses.rationale: Diagram positive bars right and negative left;6663.25 red bar says80 without minus and relative lengths do not consistently match numbers. Use equation and actual trades, not calibrated graphic values. Retain signed-volume profiles and effort/progress discrepancy; observed prints do not establish trader identity or held positions.

source_clauses.idea: p6: tape pace and spread modify level reaction
source_clauses.rationale: Retain trade-count/volume intensity, acceleration, drought, spread and BBO depletion as separate Context and candidate-quality features. Fast approach can break OR absorb; frozen tape alone cannot prove absorption. One-tick spread does not establish depth health. Compare interaction models with intensity, spread and time-of-day baselines; future execution impact accounted separately.

source_clauses.idea: pp7–8: level→aggression→hold/reload/pull→delta→tight entry
source_clauses.rationale: Faithful sequence benchmark, future Response catalogue. User USR06 permits entries from Context+Location; do not impose DOM confirmation or source claim that order flow cannot create locations. Historical high-flow/stalled-price objects can form new Location candidates. Tiny stops are an execution hypothesis, not a guaranteed precision benefit.

source_clauses.idea: p3: resistance attack, heavy buys absorbed, quick reversal/trap
source_clauses.rationale: Retain high signed effort/low progress followed by rejection; distinguish as-of stall from future reversal label. Retail/institution identity and 'highest quality' unsupported. Compare continuation, stall and reversal hazards conditioned on prior level/path; retain failures instead of selecting only turns.

source_clauses.idea: p4: reset counts before arrival; fake break→fast rejection; 300 orders across3ticks
source_clauses.rationale: Retain event-anchored local flow and zone integration, separately from session memory. Threshold300/3ticks is an example; units order count versus contracts ambiguous. Benchmark deterministic reset on approach, rolling/decayed and event-segmented accumulators; avoid discretionary hindsight reset.

source_clauses.idea: p5: bid/ask stacking and pulling with delta
source_clauses.rationale: 'Bid delta rises'/'ask delta rises' ambiguous and not equivalent to net trade delta; preserve separate quote-size additions/removals and signed executed volume. MBP1 cannot observe size pulling before a remote level becomes BBO. At unchanged BBO, net queue-size change adjusted for known trades is observable under feed assumptions; it cannot identify individual cancels/adds hidden within batching. Defer depth-wide variant pending richer feed.

source_clauses.idea: p6: selling hits bid, defended/reloading level reverses up; positive delta no upward progress traps buyers
source_clauses.rationale: Cartoon shows one enlarged cyan lower-side row; no temporal frames, transactions or scale to demonstrate reload. Retain both side-symmetric hypotheses, distinct from graphic proof. Resting size that vanishes need not have been fake; trade/quote chronology and missingness matter.

source_clauses.idea: p7: absorption heavy volume/no movement; exhaustion falling volume/smaller pushes; stopping burst
source_clauses.rationale: Retain separate effort, diminishing intensity and extreme burst specialists with common future path targets. Text says they 'point opposite ways' yet describes hard reversal versus pause/fade; not necessarily opposite directions. Compare learned interactions and multi-scale normalization rather than inferring one passive giant.

source_clauses.idea: pp3–4: bullish candle/negative delta = bullish absorption; bearish/positive = bearish
source_clauses.rationale: Retain signed effort against price response as one observable pattern, not proof of institutional inventory. p3 chart14:39–47: fall toward6748.50 with−674 delta at14:43, then332/−48/244 during recovery; boxed top rows carry both bid/ask, not explicit whole-candle labels. p4 chart15:54–16:08 mostly falls6751→below6745; isolated positive deltas206/63 occur before continued decline, then negative delta consolidation. They illustrate heterogeneous sequences, not all divergences immediately reversing.

source_clauses.idea: pp3–4: footprint 'proves' absorption after close; level→approach→disagreement→trade
source_clauses.rationale: Reject proof/identity claim. Keep causal after-close benchmark plus partial-candle/event-time challenger, accounting for confirmation delay and remaining payoff. Instrument/timeframe unspecified on crop; minute labels support one-minute examples, not universal timing.

source_clauses.idea: p5: within-candle POC shifts low→high, direction confirmation
source_clauses.rationale: Two diagram snapshots and up arrow show mode relocation, not movement of actual existing volume. Retain versioned argmax and relative candle position, dominance margin, flip count/persistence; distinguish within-current-bar updates from POC comparison across bars. Discrete argmax may jump on near ties; compare smoothed centre/mode mass and transportation of profile mass.

source_clauses.idea: p6: price new high/low without delta extreme, bearish priceup/CVDdown diagram
source_clauses.rationale: Strong conflict with FP9-01: the same sign disagreement is bullish local absorption or bearish trend divergence depending on scope/path. Retain multi-scale swings, slope and effort/progress jointly, with independently measured outcomes; never hardcode a universal directional sign. Passive buying can sustain a rise. CVD down does not reveal 'hidden sellers' (aggressive sales already observed).

source_clauses.idea: p6: huge delta/no extension named 'exhaustion print', turn1–2candles
source_clauses.rationale: Terminology conflicts DM6 exhaustion=shrinking volume; merge this burst into stopping-volume/absorption hypothesis while preserving source label. Keep diminishing intensity separately. Test horizon distributions, not fixed guaranteed1–2-bar turn.

source_clauses.idea: pp7–8: level→absorption→POCflip (+divergence)→DOM agreement
source_clauses.rationale: Retain ordered-sequence benchmark for later Response; 'one tell interest/two trade' versus3tells not exact executable rule. Compare prefix benefit, incremental flip/DOM value and waiting cost. Shared trades create correlated evidence; no independent-vote probability multiplication. Context+Location-only entry baseline mandated by USR06.

source_clauses.idea: p3: VWAP volume-weighted mean; called median and sessionPOC
source_clauses.rationale: Correct mathematical conflation: mean, median and mode differ. Retain all three as separately defined statistics and their separations; exact tick VWAP versus bar-source approximation benchmark. Image upper band labelled−2, lower+2, opposite conventional signed z; use explicit `z=(price−VWAP)/sigma`, preserve graphic error.

source_clauses.idea: pp3–4:±1 ordinary,±2/2.5 extremes,±3 rare; greater deviation→greater reversal chance
source_clauses.rationale: Retain location families and distances, not probability interpretation of an uncalibrated deviation. p3 chart20:00–04:30 UTC−4 shows alternating upper/lower touches and middle crosses; price can penetrate lower band. Compare weighted variance, robust quantile bands, forward excursion bands and asymmetric regime-conditioned levels; test monotonic reversal assumption rather than impose it.

source_clauses.idea: pp4,9: beyond1 ideally2, absorption required; avoid larger draw beyond band
source_clauses.rationale: Faithful rules as benchmarks, not global restrictions. Source itself recognizes competing farther target; core Location selector compares current-band action, deeper wait, continuation and abstain. Evaluate no-Response and refined variants with identical causal candidates.

source_clauses.idea: pp5–6: CVD cumulative aggressivebuy−sell; divergence, breakout grade, stall zones
source_clauses.rationale: Retain separate trade CVD, local/bar delta and CVD OHLC paths; source's 'realbreakout requires risingCVD' is up-break-specific and unproven. Improve with scale/cohort/asset conditioning, sign-quality flags, cross-market flow and future-path forecasts. No trader identity/open-close attribution from delta. Merge contradiction with FP9-04 rather than silently choose one story.

source_clauses.idea: p7: anchors swing, CPI/FOMC/earnings gap/session, weekly/monthly
source_clauses.rationale: Retain all anchor families and crossings/relationships. Swing anchor may be at past event time but object becomes usable only at confirmation; recompute from that past anchor without backdating availability. No inference these equal institutional cost bases; multiple-anchor density controlled in placebos and ranking. Session reset is calendar-specific, not automatically midnight.

source_clauses.idea: p8: exact settings claimed1/2/2.5
source_clauses.rationale: Enlarged inputs actually Session, source truncated '(H+L+…)', offset0, standard-deviation mode, multiplier1 enabled,2 enabled,3 disabled; Chart timeframe and 'wait for timeframe closes' checked. Style displays only bands1 and2. Thus caption2.5 not shown. Preserve recommended2.5 as separate benchmark; actual displayed example uses1/2. Exact source price formula not fully legible; likelyHLC3 but verify code/docs before asserting.

source_clauses.idea: p8 chart strong downtrend below lower band; band/mean lag
source_clauses.rationale: Chart10:00–16:30 shows price dropping from~6760 to6513, repeatedly near/outside lower bands while VWAP remains6648.6. This explicitly supports trend/remaining-opportunity conditioning and invalidation, not automatic extreme fades. Improve anchored alternatives and forward tails, compare level touches without hindsight trend label.

source_clauses.idea: p3: concepts→mechanical process→data→winner/loser comparison→refine
source_clauses.rationale: Retain reproducibility and full candidate logging, improve with frozen hypothesis registry, nested out-of-sample tuning and ablations. Repeatedly refining on same outcomes risks overfit. Journaling and systematic data can overlap; numerical inputs alone do not establish edge.

source_clauses.idea: p4: probabilistic aggregate rather than next-candle certainty
source_clauses.rationale: Retain probabilistic forecasts and distributional evaluation; rejecting certainty does not mean individual-event probabilistic prediction is impossible. Evaluate conditional next-event and horizon distributions, not deterministic promises.

source_clauses.idea: p5: trend score, history-relative values, C-scores, standard deviations, macro cycles
source_clauses.rationale: Retain measurable trend and point-in-time macro context where audited data supports it. C-score formula undisclosed; don't invent a reconstruction. Benchmark rolling z/quantiles, surprise/dispersion and revision-aware slow state; quantify incremental value at intraday horizon.

source_clauses.idea: p6: tech-bubble case using cycle, leverage, corporate borrowing, housing, valuations/P-E, capex, rates
source_clauses.rationale: Preserve proposed feature families and historical comparison method; reject undated verdict and claim every bubble needs all named conditions. No supporting dataset or calculation supplied. Defer unavailable macro series behind vintage/publication audit; avoid current-market diagnosis in planning task.

source_clauses.idea: pp7–8: asymmetric compounding1%→4% after3R win; reset after second win;100+ trades/MC
source_clauses.rationale: Heading says activates on two-win streak but mechanics increases risk after first. Arithmetic+3→+15 or−1 uses original capital, ignoring costs; current-capital percentages differ. Increased exposure is not created edge, and one-mini constraint excludes contract escalation. Preserve only benchmark/concept disposition, not primary sizing. Robust risk tests retain dependency, daily objectives and account rules; neither100 trades nor simulated maximum losses guarantees safety.

source_clauses.provenance: 88–96,195–236: participant-field interpretation, Nasdaq Trade Outline products
source_clauses.idea: Venue/contract/side fields not identities; aggregated origin/open-close data proposed
source_clauses.rationale: Verify official product coverage/cost/latency and present acquired schema; no purchase dependency; Retained distinction; external-product factuals pending verification; Data audit/options observability; Field semantics, venue representativeness, availability and incremental-value case

source_clauses.idea: pp6–7: replenishment matters more than static imbalance; aggression efficiency distinguishes discovery from stalled push
source_clauses.rationale: Retain dynamic refill/withdrawal and displacement-per-effort experts, with scale, elapsed time, spread and liquidity controls. Reject 'only question that matters' and static imbalance always noise as universal claims. Compare static, dynamic and joint models. A failed push may precede continuation if liquidity fails; no automatic fade from low efficiency.

source_clauses.idea: pp8,10: absorption requires high aggression, low response efficiency, opposite side holding/refilling; exhaustion means passive liquidity fails
source_clauses.rationale: Retain all three measurements and ordered transitions, subject to feed capability. Separate this PASSIVE exhaustion from shrinking aggressive participation called exhaustion in DOM material. Also distinguish withdrawal without consumption, consumption without replenishment and potential quote churn. Refilling is a proxy, not verified iceberg/participant inventory. Later Response details deferred; aggregate state contributes now to C/L and object memory.

source_clauses.idea: At HTF upper extreme, switch to 15m: selling achieves little, defended low/retest failure, then buyers rally. Chart ~29,830–845 strip repeatedly traversed, larger rightward rally past 30,070; red curve has no explicit legend.
source_clauses.rationale: Retain multiscale weak-seller/absorption probabilities, strip penetration and reclaim. Do not identify unlabeled curve as CVD. Need causal same-horizon measurements and executable remaining payoff after rally starts.

source_clauses.idea: Claimed 27% absorption failures without a reward system; three-tick replenishment/move in intended direction within three ticks of print. p4 schematic shows failed short at red upper zone, opposing buyers regain price and break above; tape schematic shows sequential red then green activity.
source_clauses.rationale: Preserve source-specific rule as benchmark, percentage unverified and explicitly experiential on p14. Tick can mean price increment or event count; benchmark price-distance and three-event variants separately, never silently equate time/price. Measure failed opposite aggression and signed displacement independently.

source_clauses.idea: CVD median/side check; source literally compares price with CVD median. p4 blue CVD zigzag mostly above rising white line, one dip below then recovery. No median formula, reset, units or lookback.
source_clauses.rationale: Reject cross-unit price-versus-CVD comparison. Retain CVD versus its causal median/trend plus price trend as separate features; median and trend-line versions distinct hypotheses. Absorption-only-reversal rule is source benchmark, not universal: local pullback reversal can be HTF continuation (Jumbo/WIC/OFM).

source_clauses.idea: Daily volume and delta profile; suppress near POC/interior, prefer shelves, ledges, LVN and minor nodes. p6 explicitly labels small local turn THIS IS NOT ABS; price later rises to VAH then drops. Previous-day VAH/VAL preferred over moving current-day values.
source_clauses.rationale: Modify: absorption is a measured event independent of whether trade is useful. Compare profile family and location-dependent outcomes, including Jumbo/POC internal continuation. Freeze object versions; developing levels can still be causal/useful, and developing minor nodes also move. Do not call every shelf permanent or current VA meaningless.

source_clauses.idea: High buy effort → passive sell wall → low reward → opposite sell aggression → retest of reward area with refresh before entry. Diagram p9 marks top green print, red horizontal wall, lower white retest band and subsequent decline.
source_clauses.rationale: Retain full ordered sequence as later Response specialist; current Context uses effort/result histories and Location stores originating wall/retest area. MBP-1 supports at-touch replenishment proxies only; tape repetition cannot identify same participant or passive order inventory. Compare wall entry, opposite-flow entry and retest with remaining payoff.

source_clauses.idea: Delta spike described as fastest confirmation at both VAH and VAL. Diagram uses the **same** label 'high delta spike of buyers ... absorbed passively by sellers' at upper and lower nodes, while lower price reverses up; text switches to buyers regaining control. Upper retest marks below high, lower marks around VAL after deep undershoot.
source_clauses.rationale: Preserve directional ambiguity, do not infer mirror sign from copied annotation. Compare high positive delta plus poor upside result (bearish) versus positive delta plus upward result after negative flow (bullish), and negative sell spike plus low downside result.
